approvals.description: Four-eyes rule: you cannot approve a request you initiated.

settlements.title: Settlements
settlements.releaseTitle: Ask for the release of the batch
settlements.releaseDescription: Another administrator must approve the release; the batch then goes to the bank on its date.
settlements.releaseRequested: Request sent. Another administrator must approve it.
settlements.releaseNeeded: Batch to release by Finance (four eyes) before it goes to the bank.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Platform rules. Any change requires a second approval.
settings.createdToast: Request sent. Another administrator must approve it.
settings.pending: A change is already waiting for approval.
settings.vatHint: Applied to the rounded commission. Example: 19.
settings.stampHint: Added to each order and withheld from each payout. Example: 1.000.

groupHints.finance: Rates, taxes, thresholds and the FlexiPay bank account.
groupHints.delays: Quotes, cancellation, settlement and credit validity.
groupHints.types: Active types, commission, validity and daily limit.

settings.pinLocksHint: Comma separated, e.g. 15, 30, 60. Past the last one, a full sign-in.
settings.historyHint: Settings change requests and their decision.

kyc.title: KYC files
kyc.description: Check the documents of merchants and companies. An account stays inactive until its file is approved.
kyc.pendingInfo: Check each document, then approve or reject the file. The account stays inactive until the KYC is approved.
kyc.approveMessage: The account becomes active and can use FlexiPay.
kyc.approvedToast: File approved: the account is active.
kyc.rejectedToast: File rejected: the account stays inactive.

payouts.title: Merchant payouts
payouts.description: Check each request: gross, commission, net and IBAN. Approved payouts join the next settlement batch.
payouts.pendingInfo: Check the net amount and the merchant's IBAN before approving.
payouts.approveMessage: {net} will be paid to {merchant} on IBAN {iban}, in the next settlement batch.
payouts.approvedToast: Payout approved: added to the next batch.

security.acceptEffect: Finance must approve this acceptance. The beneficiary is refunded only after this second validation.
